samples.xml_description:
<module id="comparator_4bit">
    <description>Implement a 4-bit comparator with multiple bit-level comparators in combinational logic.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="A" width_description="[3:0]">First 4-bit input operand (binary number to compare).</input>
        <input id="B" width_description="[3:0]">Second 4-bit input operand (binary number to compare).</input>
        <output id="A_greater">1-bit output indicating if A is greater than B.</output>
        <output id="A_equal">1-bit output indicating if A is equal to B.</output>
        <output id="A_less">1-bit output indicating if A is less than B.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Compares two 4-bit binary numbers A and B using combinational logic. Uses subtraction to determine if A is greater than, equal to, or less than B. Outputs are mutually exclusive.</implementation>
</module>
